scope: Independent Korean semantic and typography judgment, not a grammatical correctness standard. A phrase may be coherent without requiring indivisible line layout.

phrases.judgment: Clear modifier and head; preserve where possible. Cross-line display is not grammatical error.
A cohesive temporal expression. Useful strong candidate.
Technical compound term. Useful strong candidate.
Modifier plus noun; coherent but lawful break after modifier can remain readable.
Coherent noun phrase, but not a fixed indivisible term.
A larger clause. Prioritize 얻은 것 rather than requiring the subject to remain on its line.
Good whole clause when space allows; an adverbial/predicate break is not automatically awkward.
Excludes the head 이유. Legitimate alternative chunks include 오배송이 / 늘지 않은 이유. Gold should not penalize that choice as an objective failure.
Number-unit plus predicate; prioritize 2.4배 itself. Predicate may reasonably move to next line.
Short domain concept; reasonable strong candidate.
Contains separate units AI 도입 and 3년 차; prioritize these rather than the entire string.
Long modifier clause. Splitting object from predicate can remain readable.
Long object/predicate/head group; prioritize 설득하는 법. Entire phrase is layout dependent.
Coherent domain concept; prioritize 예외 상황. Appending 처리 is reasonable but not mandatory.

recommendation: Maintain stronger and softer phrase sets separately; allow acceptable alternative boundaries. Report gold match coverage and human preference separately. Freeze any revised gold for future experiments; retain old scores unchanged.
